metadata.title: Schema width survey: Wikidata qualifier schemas (WDQS snapshot of 2026-09-24) and the Biolink Model v4.4.5, with generated schema files and results
metadata.description:
Inputs and outputs of a survey of the acyclicity class (Berge, gamma, beta, alpha or cyclic) and the hypertree widths (hw, ghw, fhw and tw) of knowledge-hypergraph relation-type schemas, read as hypergraphs with roles as vertices and relations as hyperedges: the Wikidata qualifier schemas, declared (allowed-qualifier constraints of 1,155 properties) and observed (qualifier usage of the properties in use, over the whole dump and over the items with an English Wikipedia article), and the 103 association classes of the Biolink Model v4.4.5.

Contents (one zip archive, paths relative to the source repository): the raw Wikidata Query Service results of 2026-09-24 with their sha256 manifest; the exact per-property qualifier-usage counts from the Wikidata JSON dump of 2026-09-22 (the count source of the observed schemas); the Biolink Model v4.4.5 source files; the generated schema files (khg-relation-schema/1.0.0) with provenance; one full report per survey row (class, witness, widths with methods, validated decompositions, lower-bound witnesses, every solver attempt); the survey table, figure, HyperBench baseline and solver log. README.md describes every file, the licences and how to reproduce the survey with the repository at the commit it names.

The Wikidata Query Service is live and cannot return the same bytes again; this deposit keeps the snapshot the measured schema files were generated from. The checker, khg-width (MIT), and the survey scripts are in the source repository.
